words.example: Applicants must hold a relevant degree or diploma.

exercises.original: The post requires a qualification in engineering from a recognised university.
exercises.zh: 這個職位要求具備認可大學頒授的工程學位或文憑。
exercises.upgrade: degree or diploma · 學位或文憑；學歷資格

options.explanation: from a recognised university makes the qualification specifically academic.
常指可證明教育、訓練或專業身份的資格證明，可被列出、上載或核實。 本題的決定性線索是 an academic award from a university；這裡需要的是「正式學歷資格」。因此 credential 雖與 qualification 有關，但究竟是證明文件、實際能力、先決條件、正式認證、法定許可或學歷並不最吻合。
由認證機構正式確認達到標準，常經考試並可能需要定期更新。 本題的決定性線索是 an academic award from a university；這裡需要的是「正式學歷資格」。因此 certification 雖與 qualification 有關，但究竟是證明文件、實際能力、先決條件、正式認證、法定許可或學歷並不最吻合。
由政府／監管機構授予的法定許可，允許從事受規管活動。 本題的決定性線索是 an academic award from a university；這裡需要的是「正式學歷資格」。因此 licence 雖與 qualification 有關，但究竟是證明文件、實際能力、先決條件、正式認證、法定許可或學歷並不最吻合。
指職位／任務實際需要的技能或能力，不必有正式證書。 本題的決定性線索是 an academic award from a university；這裡需要的是「正式學歷資格」。因此 required skill 雖與 qualification 有關，但究竟是證明文件、實際能力、先決條件、正式認證、法定許可或學歷並不最吻合。
是在進入課程、職位或下一階段之前必須先具備的條件。 本題的決定性線索是 an academic award from a university；這裡需要的是「正式學歷資格」。因此 prerequisite 雖與 qualification 有關，但究竟是證明文件、實際能力、先決條件、正式認證、法定許可或學歷並不最吻合。

exercises.original: She completed a two-year qualification in graphic design at college.
exercises.zh: 她在學院完成了一個兩年制平面設計文憑課程。

exercises.original: Candidates must provide evidence of an overseas qualification equivalent to the local award.
exercises.zh: 申請人必須提供與本地學歷相等的海外學位或文憑證明。
exercises.upgrade: degree or diploma · 學位或文憑；學歷資格

falseSynonyms.zh: credential 強調可出示、可核實的資格證明；qualification 還可指技能、經驗或先決條件。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The employer verified her credentials. Communication is an important qualification for the role.

falseSynonyms.zh: certification 是由機構正式認證達標；一般 qualification 未必經過認證程序。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The technician holds safety certification. Experience is a useful qualification.

falseSynonyms.zh: degree 是特定大學學歷；qualification 可以是文憑、證書、牌照、技能或經驗。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She has a degree in chemistry. The role requires several qualifications.

falseSynonyms.zh: licence 是法律／監管許可；qualification 可在沒有法定牌照要求的職位中使用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A licence is required to practise. The job requires strong analytical qualifications.

falseSynonyms.zh: skill 是能力；qualification 可以是技能，但也可以是學歷、認證或法定資格。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Writing is an important skill. The applicant has the required qualification.

falseSynonyms.zh: prerequisite 是進入某階段前必須先滿足的條件；qualification 不一定是『事前門檻』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Statistics is a prerequisite for the advanced module. Her experience is a valuable qualification.

falseSynonyms.zh: experience 是實際經歷；它可以構成 qualification，但兩者不等同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She has five years of experience. That experience is an important qualification for the role.

falseSynonyms.zh: qualification 是名詞；qualify 是動詞，表示具備資格／符合條件。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Her qualification is recognised. She qualifies for the programme.
